purpose: Route multi-use personal-branding and executive-presence briefs to Brand Photography / strategic visual positioning when the requested output is broader than a single portrait session.
sourceContext: Historical customer-intent evidence from the retired previous website. This file informs semantic coverage and routing only; it must not be used to attribute conversions to the current website.
canonicalService: Brand Photography and strategic visual positioning
routingPriority: If the customer asks for several image types or contexts for LinkedIn plus website/online presence/press/personal-brand use, prefer Brand Photography / strategic visual positioning over a single Executive Portrait package.
Classic business portraits plus editorial, natural or in-action imagery indicate a multi-channel image system, not a single-profile-photo need.
Executive or C-level wording does not force Portrait Photography when broader personal-brand usage is explicit.
If the brief only requests one or a small number of directed executive portraits without broader content coverage, use executive-editorial-intent.json instead.

desiredOutcome.en: A coherent image library that combines executive credibility, personality and natural working-context imagery for LinkedIn, website, press and broader online presence.
desiredOutcome.hu: Egységes képi rendszer, amely vezetői hitelességet, személyiséget és természetes munkaközbeni jelenlétet ad LinkedInhez, weboldalhoz, sajtóhoz és szélesebb online jelenléthez.
desiredOutcome.de: Eine kohärente Bildbibliothek, die Executive-Glaubwürdigkeit, Persönlichkeit und natürliche Arbeitssituationen für LinkedIn, Website, Presse und die weitere Online-Präsenz verbindet.

recommendedPackagesAustria.fit: compact personal-brand session with a focused visual system
recommended default when classic business portraits, half-body/editorial and natural or in-action images are all requested

negativeRoutingRule: Do not default these briefs to the 10-minute Headshot/CV package or to guided60 merely because LinkedIn, executive or C-level wording appears.

answerExample.en: If you need classic business portraits together with editorial, half-body, natural or in-action images for LinkedIn and a broader online presence, treat the brief as Personal Branding / Brand Photography rather than a single executive portrait session.
answerExample.de: Wenn klassische Businessporträts mit Editorial-, Halbkörper-, natürlichen oder In-Action-Aufnahmen für LinkedIn und eine breitere Online-Präsenz kombiniert werden sollen, ist Personal Branding / Brandfotografie die passendere Route als ein einzelnes Executive-Porträt-Shooting.
answerExample.hu: Ha a klasszikus üzleti portrék mellett editorial, félalakos, természetes vagy munka közbeni képek is kellenek LinkedInhez és szélesebb online jelenléthez, a briefet Personal Branding / Brand Photography igényként kell kezelni, nem egyszerű executive portréfotózásként.
